title: This Deep Sea Giant Went 5 Years Without a Single Meal

scenes.text: This deep sea giant stopped eating in 2009. It lived five more years.
It was a giant isopod, a deep sea crustacean about thirty centimetres long.
At Toba Aquarium in Japan, its last meal was a fifty gram mackerel on the second of January 2009.
After that, it never ate again.
In February 2014, it was found dead. Five years and forty three days with no food.
One small fish. Then five years of nothing.

description:
A giant isopod at Toba Aquarium in Japan stopped eating in January 2009 and lived until February 2014.
Its last meal was a fifty gram mackerel, and it went five years and forty three days without food.
What do you think kept it going? Tell us below.
first_comment: A giant isopod ate once in 2009 and then nothing until 2014. What is the longest you think any animal could go without food?
